reason: Ivan asked for a phone nav layout change: logo stays on top, no top nav pill on phones, nav moves to a compact bottom bar. Nothing existed that owned phone nav placement; the closest skill covers scroll strips, which the phone nav no longer uses.

Spacing on the bottom pill was flagged again after frames went out, despite the existing measure-first rule. This episode gives concrete pitfalls for this bar: an unsized conditional item, the 332 px pane floor misreported as 320, and the need for numbers in captions.

The Organisers item was removed from the phone bar on 2026-11-22, so the bar is now two items. The skill still says three labels at 375 px and names Organisers as a bar item. Rewriting to the current two-item state and keeping the equal-width rule for any future item.

Ivan questioned why Events was highlighted on an event page and asked for the tint to go. The rule that only the current page is highlighted lives in CLAUDE.md but not in this skill, so the next edit could repeat the mistake.

Spacing on this bar was flagged again after a round that had only measured one width and closed by saying phone width was not checked. Measuring every width before the frame goes out prevents a second round of the same complaint.
